     this.header(

part.text:
Implemented the redirect header-injection fix.

- `src/context.ts`: `c.redirect()` now percent-encodes raw CR/LF as `%0D`/`%0A` before setting `Location`, while leaving existing URLs untouched. Non-ASCII URLs still go through `encodeURI()`.
- `src/context.test.ts`: added regression tests covering raw `\r`, `\n`, `\r\n`, and preservation of already percent-encoded `%0D%0A` (both uppercase and lowercase).

Verification:

```
pnpm exec vp test --run src/context.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       65 passed (65)
```
